verdict.rationale: Better Auth ships both an API Key plugin (create/manage/verify keys with custom expiration, remaining-count and refill limits) and an MCP plugin that lets the app act as an OAuth authorization server specifically for MCP (AI agent) clients — directly supporting scoped credential issuance for agents. However, the evidence never explicitly documents fine-grained permission/scope assignment on API keys (only expiration/rate-limit controls), so least-privilege scoping is only partially evidenced. Missing for 10: explicit scope/permission fields on API keys, worked example of issuing a least-privilege credential to an agent, independent confirmation of this workflow.
